title: Does Scaling Toward AGI Depend on What System-1 Lets System-2 Execute?
abstract: arXiv:2610.39497v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Progress toward artificial general intelligence (AGI) has largely relied on scaling a resource-intensive executive, System-2, through larger models, more data and compute, longer reasoning, and more agents. We ask whether the next stage may come instead from co-designing it with System-1, a lightweight, semantically aware predictor that evaluates candidate interactions before execution, so that System-2 acts only on those worth their cost. Our answer is a qualified yes. We study \textit{conditional interaction}, a predict--gate--execute--update loop: System-1 estimates each candidate's utility, System-2 executes those admitted by an adaptive threshold, and the outcomes update System-1. The loop spans training, test-time reasoning, adaptive decision-making, and agentic tool use, with utility and cost defined by the application. translated_title: 迈向AGI的扩展是否取决于System-1允许System-2执行什么？
translated_abstract: 迈向通用人工智能（AGI）的进展在很大程度上依赖于通过更大的模型、更多的数据和算力、更长的推理以及更多的智能体来扩展资源密集型的执行系统——System-2。我们提出疑问：下一阶段的进展是否可能转而来自于将System-2与System-1协同设计？System-1是一个轻量级、具备语义感知能力的预测器，它在执行之前评估候选交互，从而使System-2只执行那些值得付出代价的交互。我们的答案是有条件的肯定。我们研究了“条件交互”，即一个“预测—门控—执行—更新”循环：System-1估计每个候选交互的效用，System-2执行那些通过自适应阈值筛选的交互，而执行结果反过来更新System-1。该循环涵盖训练、测试时推理、自适应决策以及智能体工具使用等场景，其中效用与成本由具体应用定义。在理想筛选和执行成本相同的条件下，执行计算量可降低接近$1/\rho_u$的倍数（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出通过轻量级、语义感知的System-1预测器与System-2协同设计的“预测—门控—执行—更新”条件交互循环，让System-2只执行值得付出成本的候选交互，从而在迈向AGI的道路上大幅降低执行计算开销。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes co-designing the resource-intensive System-2 with a lightweight, semantically-aware System-1 predictor through a predict–gate–execute–update "conditional interaction" loop, so that System-2 only executes interactions worth their cost, substantially reducing execution compute on the path to AGI.
